title: Agents & Proxies
description: The five OTel-Metrics-API services: the MCP proxy sidecar (demo_mcp_proxy), the 2-tier LLM router (demo_llm_proxy), and the three agent runtimes (mastra_agent, langchain_agent, openai_agent). Prometheus scrapes all five (monitoring/prometheus.yml) via the OTel SDK's Prometheus exporter rather than prom-client directly — see the MCP Servers dashboard for that half of the fleet — but both end up in the same Prometheus with the same metric shape, so the PromQL here reads identically.

options.content: Each service wraps its own single dispatch point with one duration histogram and one error counter — pure observation, the wrapped function's control flow and return value are unchanged. Metric prefixes: `mcpproxy_` (MCP proxy, labeled by JSON-RPC `method`), `llmproxy_` (LLM router, labeled by model `tier`), `mastra_` / `langchainagent_` / `openaiagent_` (the three agent runtimes — no labels; each has exactly one `/run` dispatch point). The three agents' own try/except already swallows agent/tool/LLM errors into an AG-UI RUN_ERROR SSE event instead of raising, so each `_run_errors_total` counts only something escaping that handler entirely (a framework-level failure) — an agent that reports its OWN error to the chat still shows here as a normal, error-free run. The Logs panel is Tier 2 — Grafana Alloy tailing every container's stdout into Loki.
